summary: Ship YAML data files in fixos package

delivery.outcome: The built wheel and sdist ship the runtime YAML data (feature profile/catalog files and builtin profiles), so `fixos features profiles`, `features audit`, `features install` and profile-aware commands work from a pip install instead of silently listing nothing.
nonGoals: No source or test file changes; packaging declaration only.
No new runtime dependency; package-data uses existing setuptools build backend.
No version bump or release in this ticket.

architecture.decision: Declare `[tool.setuptools.package-data]` for the fixos package covering `features/data/*.yaml`, `features/data/profiles/*.yaml` and `profiles/*.yaml`; setuptools package-data feeds both wheel and sdist.
architecture.rollback: Revert the pyproject.toml package-data block; the wheel returns to its previous file set.

commands: python -m pip wheel . -w /tmp/fixos-wheel --no-deps && python -m zipfile -l /tmp/fixos-wheel/fixos-*.whl | grep -c 'yaml'
